$comment: Which theme variables the design system publishes as tokens, in what order, with what usage note. VALUES ARE NEVER WRITTEN HERE: app/scripts/design-system.mjs reads them from the live cascade (theme.css > theme-cleanspace.css > theme-flat.css > index.css :root). Every :root variable must appear exactly once: as a token below, or in `recipes` (kept in bundle.css). test-design-system.mjs fails on an unclassified or missing variable.
name: Clean Space

color.note: One theme: the app ships light only. Values are the final cascade: theme.css defaults, CleanSpace colour overrides, then the flat treatment.

tokens.name: color-brand-primary-50
tokens.usage: Lightest ink tint. Section-tab count pills and a few pay/HR chips; as primary-bg it is the hover wash of outline buttons, menu options and crew chips.

tokens.name: color-brand-primary-100
tokens.usage: Light ink tint; as primary-soft it marks the selected option in a select menu and the hover of the back pill.

tokens.name: color-brand-primary-400
tokens.usage: Medium ink (primary-light). Kept for the legacy gradient recipes; not painted directly by CleanSpace components.

tokens.name: color-brand-primary-500
tokens.usage: The brand black. Primary buttons, table header bands, avatars, ink on gold CTAs. Text on it is color-text-on-primary (17.7:1).

tokens.name: color-brand-primary-600
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed black (primary-hover) for .btn-primary.

tokens.name: color-brand-primary-700
tokens.usage: Deepest ink (primary-deep): the desktop sidebar rail, the login backdrop, and the label on the gold active nav pill (14:1).

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary-50
tokens.usage: Gold wash for gentle highlights (starred rows, pay hints); same family as the upcoming-clean row tint.

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary-100
tokens.usage: Stronger gold wash: drop targets and client-authored message bubbles.

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary-400
tokens.usage: Light gold for accents on dark (pay-rail totals, the "now" card).

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary-500
tokens.usage: CleanSpace gold. Affirmative CTAs (.btn-gold / .btn-success), the active nav pill, the section-tab underline, the upcoming status. Gold is light: text on it is always ink (color-brand-primary-500, 12.5:1), never white. On white it separates by only 1.4:1, so it never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary-600
tokens.usage: Gold hover for CTAs; ink on it holds 9.2:1.

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary-700
tokens.usage: Dark gold for small marks on gold washes (tips, the current-step dot).

tokens.name: color-neutral-50
tokens.usage: Near-white ink on the black rail: nav hover labels and the brand title (19:1 on color-brand-primary-700).

tokens.name: color-neutral-100
tokens.usage: Sidebar body text; cancelled timeline card fill; the value behind color-border-subtle.

tokens.name: color-neutral-200
tokens.usage: Sidebar nav labels on the black rail (16:1); the value behind color-border-default.

tokens.name: color-neutral-300
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb, the off-state toggle track, secondary-button hover border; the value behind color-border-strong. As a track on white it separates by 1.5:1 only (source value).

tokens.name: color-neutral-400
tokens.usage: Placeholder text on every field, cancelled markers, sidebar section labels on the rail (7.8:1). As a placeholder on field-bg it measures 2.3:1: deliberately faint, a hint that must never read like a value.

tokens.name: color-neutral-500
tokens.usage: Slate: the neutral status fill (.badge.slate, white text 4.8:1) and the mixed-state toggle knob.

tokens.name: color-neutral-600
tokens.usage: Faint text (color-text-faint): timestamps, kbd hints. 7.6:1 on white, 7.0:1 on the page ground.

tokens.name: color-neutral-700
tokens.usage: Count pills on the black rail.

tokens.name: color-neutral-800
tokens.usage: Body and muted text (color-text-body / color-text-muted): 14.6:1 on white, 13.4:1 on the page ground, 12.2:1 on a well.

tokens.name: color-neutral-900
tokens.usage: Headings, names and values (color-text-primary): 17.9:1 on white, 16.4:1 on the page ground.

tokens.name: color-surface-offwhite
tokens.usage: L1 page ground, the cool light gray the whole app sits on.

tokens.name: color-surface-base
tokens.usage: The app background (page-bg). Points at color-surface-offwhite.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: L2: cards, tables, modals and row-cards. White, one step above the ground.

tokens.name: color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: L0: wells inside a card and containers that hold row-cards (inset-bg). One step below the ground.

tokens.name: color-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets: crisp white.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, names, values. Legible on surface-raised, surface-base and surface-sunken (16:1 and up).

tokens.name: color-text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and table cells, on any surface (12:1 and up).

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary text. In CleanSpace muted equals body (neutral-800): de-emphasis comes from size, weight and case, never from a pale gray.

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, captions, kbd hints (7.6:1 on white). Placeholders use color-neutral-400 instead.

tokens.name: color-text-on-primary

tokens.name: color-border-subtle

tokens.name: color-border-default

tokens.name: color-border-strong

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: The hairline on every card, table, field and button edge (CleanSpace value). It separates by elevation, not contrast (1.2:1 on white): never delete it; if an edge vanishes, bump it a step.

tokens.name: color-link

spacing.note: Strict 4px grid, then the role aliases (STRUCTURE.md §1) that components read instead of a step: the gap ladder and the container paddings.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Zero.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges and tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gap: chips, icon + label, button clusters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar or form row; horizontal padding inside fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a button; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet side padding; detail-tab spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; main top padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: 28px step: the New Job column gap, the embedded detail-tab gap and the message pane's icon buttons. The dense control height is control-height-xs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px step: launchpad tile icons, the sheet grip, the New Job icon slot, the messenger's icon buttons and roomy empty-state padding. The action-button height is btn-height.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Main side padding; 40px tap targets for icon buttons on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large vertical breathing room (empty states, the mobile search inset).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The base of the main bottom padding (64 + 16).

tokens.name: gap-inline
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-2 (8px): chips, icon + label, button clusters. Read by the page and detail head actions, modal actions, table controls and the toast stack.

tokens.name: gap-control
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-3 (12px): between controls in a toolbar or form row. Read by the filter bar, the list pager and the sheet footer.

tokens.name: gap-card
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-4 (16px): stacked cards and form groups. Read by the sheet body.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-6 (24px): between page sections. Defined for the contract; no rule reads it yet.

tokens.name: card-pad-sm
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-4 (16px): dense cards, stat tiles and nested blocks. Defined for the contract; no rule reads it yet.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-5 (20px): the default .card padding.

tokens.name: card-pad-lg
tokens.usage: Role alias of space-6 (24px): the modal card and roomy cards.

radius.note: CleanSpace rounds harder than the shell: 10px controls, 20px cards, pills for anything status-like.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks: kbd hints, the search highlight, detail sub-chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: CleanSpace override (the shell default is 8px): buttons and inputs via btn-radius and input-radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: CleanSpace override (shell 12px): cards, table frames, modals, filter bars via card-radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of the bottom sheet. Smaller than radius-lg here, because the lg override jumped past it.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and discs: badges, tag chips, segmented tracks, the back pill, avatars, toggles.

tokens.name: card-radius
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-lg: cards, table frames, modals, toasts, filter bars.

tokens.name: btn-radius
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-md: buttons, row menus, callouts, menu options.

tokens.name: input-radius
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-md: inputs, select triggers and their menus, search fields.

tokens.name: badge-radius
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-full: badges, avatars, toggles, count pills.

shadow.note: Flat: hairlines carry hierarchy. One overlay shadow (shadow-overlay) is the target for anything floating, though the picker menus still use shadow-md; plus two decorative rings that are never a focus indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle lift, a shell primitive. Flat CleanSpace surfaces carry a hairline instead; only the messenger's active segment uses it.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The crew, tag and contact picker menus: a second overlay tier beside shadow-overlay, where STRUCTURE §5 allows one.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The overlay step. The kit reads it through shadow-overlay; feature panels and popovers still name it directly (user menu, bell panel, filter and assign popovers, the email modal, the messenger).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Role alias of shadow-lg: the one overlay shadow (STRUCTURE.md §5). Read by the modal card, toasts, the mobile sheet, the select menu and the search and message menus.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed feel, kept in the scale; unused by CleanSpace components.

tokens.name: ring-inset
tokens.usage: Inset 1px ink outline on selected tiles and cells.

controlHeight.note: Control heights (STRUCTURE.md §1): the tiers a control's height should come from. Today only .btn, .btn-sm (through btn-height / btn-height-sm) and .btn-icon read them. This build's action button is the sm tier (32px, UI_RULES §115) and its dense size the xs tier (28px). md grows to 40px on phones (640px and below).

tokens.name: control-height-xs
tokens.usage: Dense tier, 28px: .btn-sm (through btn-height-sm) and the icon button (.btn-icon).

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact tier, 32px: this build's action button (through btn-height).

tokens.name: control-height-md
tokens.usage: The contract's default tier: 36px, 40px on phones. Defined for the contract; no rule reads it yet (fields are about 43px from their padding).

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large CTA and the 44px tap-target floor. Defined for the contract; no rule reads it yet.

tokens.name: btn-height
tokens.usage: Role alias of control-height-sm: the one action-button height (.btn, 32px). Re-point it to move every standard-size .btn; .btn-sm reads btn-height-sm, and the clock control, the phone Messaging header and the message-pane actions set their own heights.

tokens.name: btn-height-sm
tokens.usage: Role alias of control-height-xs: .btn-sm (28px), for data-table rows and named dense clusters only.

borderWidth.note: Line widths (STRUCTURE.md §1): the 1px hairline carries hierarchy (the flat doctrine), 2px marks fields and emphasis, 3px is for left-accent rails only. The focus ring is 2px wide.

tokens.name: border-width-sm
tokens.usage: The hairline: cards, table wraps, the filter bar, the sheet footer, toasts, menus, icon buttons and tag chips.

tokens.name: border-width-md
tokens.usage: Fields, the select trigger and the select menu: the 2px transparent border the input-border gradient paints.

tokens.name: border-width-lg
tokens.usage: Left-accent rails only. Defined for the contract; no rule reads it yet.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: 2px: the spread of the input-focus-shadow ring (UI_RULES §119).

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: 2px gap before an outline-style :focus-visible ring. Defined for the contract; no rule reads it yet.
